proposal.summary: GitLab projects API pagination can be skipped in affected versions, potentially leading to denial of service on certain instances.
proposal.affected_product: GitLab all versions starting from 15.2 before 16.1.5; all versions starting from 16.2 before 16.2.5; all versions starting from 16.3 before 16.3.1
proposal.cwe_quote: the projects API pagination can be skipped, potentially leading to DoS on certain instances.

AV.quote: the projects API pagination can be skipped

A.quote: potentially leading to DoS on certain instances.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm reproducibility and obtain request/response examples that demonstrate pagination skipping; collect information about required attacker privileges and whether requests must be authenticated; assess resource impact and develop a patch to enforce pagination limits.
